legal.privacyLead: EduVerse stores the minimum it needs to work: your EduID email, and the study activity you choose to save.
legal.privacyP1: We store your email address, the display name you set (if any), and your bookmarks, study plans and focus sessions. Nothing else.
legal.privacyP2: Your password is handled entirely by Supabase Auth. We never see it and never store it.
legal.privacyP3: We do not sell your data and we run no third-party advertising trackers. The only analytics we use is Cloudflare Web Analytics, which counts visits, not people.
legal.privacyP4: You can ask us to delete your account and everything attached to it at any time.
legal.termsLead: Use EduVerse to study. Be decent. That is the whole thing.
legal.termsP1: Content on EduVerse is provided for study purposes. The Egyptian Ministry of Education curriculum is the reference — where our material and the official curriculum differ, the official curriculum wins.
legal.termsP2: Accounts are for personal use. Do not share your EduID, and do not upload or publish material you do not have the right to share.
legal.termsP3: EduVerse is provided as is, without warranty. Exam timetables, progress figures and timers are study aids, not official records.
legal.termsP4: We may change or retire parts of EduVerse. We will tell you about any change that affects data you have saved.
legal.contactLead: Something wrong, or something you want us to build? Say so.
legal.contactResponse: We usually reply within two working days.
